fields.oneLiner: PitchRoll marks attendance at a cricket academy in thirty seconds on the coach's phone and messages the parents of the boys who did not turn up.
fields.jobStory:
When the 6am batch starts at a cricket academy and eleven of the eighteen boys are on the ground, the coach wants attendance marked before the first drill so I can send the seven absent boys' parents a message by 6.10 instead of writing names on a register that nobody reads until the fee date.

Who has this job: coaches at private cricket academies in Nagpur running three or four batches a day, 15 to 30 boys per batch, monthly fees between 1,200 and 3,000 rupees. There are roughly 40 such academies around Nagpur and I have the list because they all play in the same district league. I spoke to five coaches and two academy owners.

What they do instead: a paper register in the academy office that the coach fills at the end of the session from memory, or nothing. One academy owner told me he only finds out a boy stopped coming when the parent stops paying, which is usually six weeks later. Two academies use a WhatsApp group where the coach posts a photo of the register, which means the register still exists and someone still has to read it.
fields.trafficTestNotes: I shared the page in my section WhatsApp group on campus, in our batch group, and in my family group where my uncle coaches part time. My roommate also put it on his Instagram story. Out of that I got 3 signups, which are my uncle, one senior from college who said he would try it, and one of my section mates who I think signed up to be nice. I know this is not a real traffic test and I ran out of time this week because of the finance quiz on Thursday. I did try to post in a Nagpur cricket coaches Facebook group but the admin has not approved my join request since 6 Sep, and I did not want to spend on ads before the page copy is final. I have a plan for next week: go to the district league ground on Sunday where six or seven academies are in one place, and hand out the QR. So the honest position is 3 signups, all from people who know me or know my family, and no money spent.
